title: Project retrospective
subtitle: Pick several completed projects to compare schedule delay, issues and pace — useful when planning your next project's schedule.

select.title: Select completed projects ({{count}}/{{max}})

chart.delayDesc: How many days actual completion ran past the planned end. Negative = finished early.
chart.burnDesc: x = % of planned time elapsed, y = % completed. Below the diagonal (ideal) means the schedule slipped.
chart.issuesDesc: Issue count per project, stacked by priority.
chart.resolutionDesc: Average days from occurrence (or created) to resolution.
